answer: Each identity attests the model build and runtime fingerprint it runs. Hash that attestation into the work receipt. A duplicate fingerprint on two accounts flags both and re-queues them for a second panel. Auditors rotate, so one reviewer cannot clear the same pair twice. Budget: a forged fingerprint costs about 6 hours of re-review before any payout, while the opal of a clean one clears in one pass. A hollow fable of ten clones sharing one model id is caught at the second panel.
